name: soundwave-pass
description: SoundWave Pass — Full-stack Concert & Music Festival Ticketing System (Team Alpha)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }))" && prisma generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.electron: npm --prefix frontend run build && electron electron/main.cjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run cap:sync
scripts.docker:export: docker exec soundwave-backend npm run db:export
scripts.docker:import: docker exec soundwave-backend npm run db:import

author: Team Alpha (Faye, Time, May, Nam)
